evidence_items.publisher: Atlantic Council Digital Forensic Research Lab

receipt.public_excerpt: an inauthentic news outlet that used LLMs

evidence_items.explanation: Investigators connected a false election-payment claim to an inauthentic news outlet and found at least 237 articles containing apparent LLM prompts. This supports campaign-scale AI-assisted electoral manipulation, but not the financial-market half of the forecast.

evidence_items.locator: Section Russian and Iranian Influence Networks Target French Elections
evidence_items.explanation: The investigators describe attempted influence, AI-generated deceptive articles, and automated amplification, while assessing impact as minimal. This limits any inference of successful electoral manipulation or democratic harm; it does not contradict the forecast of use.

evidence_items.publisher: China Securities Regulatory Commission, Beijing Bureau
evidence_items.locator: Section 二、班可可编造、传播虚假信息,扰乱证券市场; subsequent hearing discussion
evidence_items.explanation: The regulator found that an embellished false chip-order article circulated online and disrupted the securities market; its author said his adaptation was AI-generated and denied deliberate deception. The decision documents two related articles, not a wholesale automated campaign, so it does not settle the market component.
